WORKERS PROTEST DELAY IN WAGE HIKE BILL

Members of the Partido ng Manggagawa held a protest at the Boy Scout Circle in Quezon City on Thursday, June 12, denouncing House Speaker Martin Romualdez, Senate President Chiz Escudero, and President Bongbong Marcos for allegedly failing workers by not certifying the ₱200 wage hike as urgent.

The protest came a day after both chambers of Congress adjourned sine die without ratifying the wage hike bill.

📸 The STAR/Michael Varcas
